messages:
Rina: Quick thread — focused on filename UX + automatic splitting in the vectors export modal. figma: https://figma.com/file/new-ui
Rina: Questions: should edited filename be used as base for parts? how explicit should we be about per-file limits?
Ethan - Eng: Edited filename should be the base: userfile.part1.csv.gz. Backend will stream and create parts at 10k rows/file by default. Gzip optional.
Maya (PM): Product asks: show a clear line: 'Files will be split into N parts of up to 10k rows each.' and preview the actual part names. Also provide an option to change rows-per-file (dropdown: 1k / 5k / 10k).
Noor - A11y: Accessibility nits: part name preview must be in an editable input with label for SRs. Announce number of parts when options change (aria-live). Confirmation needed for >50k rows. Ensure color contrast for part badges.
Rina: UI: show live estimate under filename: "Estimated: 23,000 rows ≈ 27 MB (CSV, gzip)". When user edits base name update preview instantly.
Ethan - Eng: Implementation note: client estimates use rows * dim * 4 bytes heuristic, we'll refine later. Parts will be zipped server-side; front-end shows download link to zip containing parts.
Maya (PM): Copy suggestion for the export header: "Download embeddings (CSV • JSONL) — choose columns & chunking". Keep it concise.
Noor - A11y: Tooltips must be reachable via keyboard and dismissable via ESC. Add aria-describedby on the 'Split into parts' checkbox linking to the explanation.
Rina: Final asks before I update figma: - confirm header copy (Maya ok) - include editable filename + live preview - show per-file row limit and editable rows-per-file control - aria-live announcements for parts estimate - confirmation for huge exports
Maya (PM): Confirmed. Prioritize the a11y announcements and the filename preview behavior for this sprint.
deploy-bot: design snapshot uploaded: https://redwood.design/snapshots/1772223335
Noor - A11y: I'll run a quick keyboard + SR pass once figma is updated.
